entities.title: Welcome to EXTANTRA
entities.author: tedwordnelson
entities.excerpt: Welcome to my personal blog where I share thoughts on technology, creativity, and digital experiences.
entities.content:
Welcome to EXTANTRA, my personal space on the internet where I share thoughts, projects, and experiences.

This blog will feature content about:

  • Technology and programming
  • Creative projects and digital art
  • Music production and audio experiments
  • Gaming and interactive experiences
  • Whatever else catches my interest

Feel free to explore the different sections of the site using the navigation menu. You'll find my music, photos, 3D models, videos, and drawings.

Thanks for visiting, and check back soon for more content!
